statement: Anthropic reports data center capacity constraints while placing about $250 million in initial chip orders with startup Fractile plus capacity agreements with Riot Platforms and Volta Infra Holdings.
why: A frontier lab buying from an alternative silicon startup and locking third-party capacity shows compute demand running ahead of available supply and spilling into non-Nvidia channels.

impact.mechanism: Capacity scarcity pushes a large buyer toward alternative accelerators and leased capacity, adding supply routes while confirming excess compute demand.

evidence.excerpt: Anthropic faces data center capacity constraints and seeks custom hardware tailored to its specific needs
approximately $250 million in initial orders from UK-based startup Fractile, plus capacity agreements with Riot Platforms and Volta Infra Holdings

confidence.basis: Single secondary outlet; order figure is approximate and not company-filed.

entity: Anthropic / Google / NVIDIA (custom silicon competitive displacement)
